title: Google to invest $5 million in IIT Kharagpur to support Artificial Intelligence research
description: Google has announced a $5 million funding initiative for the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur. This funding will support AI research focusing on Indic languages, agriculture, and educational technology. The initiative aims to improve AI training and curriculum development for students and faculty. Additionally, Google plans to enhance IIT Kharagpur's AI frameworks and tooling across its campus. This collaboration seeks to foster innovation and benefit communities in India and beyond.
